meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 让项目能接入 Matrix 聊天服务：从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册频道、安装固定依赖、修补兼容性并构建验证。集成后，机器人可通过任意 Matrix 服务器收发私聊和群聊消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Matrix 频道、把项目接到 Matrix 服务器，或在 /setup 流程配置此通道时触发。

say.text: 帮我的项目接入 Matrix 聊天。
say.note: 将执行添加 Matrix 频道的步骤。

say.text: 给机器人添加 Matrix 渠道，服务器用 matrix.org。
say.note: 会复制适配器并提示提供账号信息。

say.text: 配置一个单独的 Matrix 机器人账号来收发消息。
say.note: 需要你准备好 bot 的用户名密码或 token。

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix as a chat channel: copies the adapter, registers it, installs a pinned dependency, patches ESM imports, then builds and tests. After that the bot can message via any Matrix homeserver.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Matrix chat or integrate a Matrix server into the project, or during a /setup flow that configures channels.

say_en.text: Add Matrix chat to my project.
Give the bot a Matrix channel using matrix.org.
say_en.note: Copies adapter and prompts for credentials.

say_en.text: Configure a separate Matrix bot account for messaging.
say_en.note: You'll need a username/password or token.
